explanation: Qin Shi Huang linked earlier walls after 221 BC, but the famous stretches near Beijing, such as Badaling, were built by the Ming in the 1500s.

claims.text: The brick and stone sections of the Great Wall that visitors usually see were built under the Ming dynasty (1368 to 1644).
The Qin, Han and Tang did not build the brick and stone Ming sections of the wall.
Qin Shi Huang linked earlier walls after unifying China in 221 BC.
The Badaling section of the Great Wall near Beijing was built under the Ming in the 1500s.
